name: Parents’ 30th anniversary trip

ideas.name: Timor-Leste
ideas.note: Dry in July–August, mountains to 2,986 m, independence history; awkward flights via Bali or Darwin.

decisions.title: Which window: 12–26 July or 19 July–1 August?
Shortlist to vote on: Georgia+Armenia, Norway, Kyrgyzstan (Mom unsure about Central Asia), Canada (over budget)

notes: Criteria from the family: nowhere we have been; a trip we would not do otherwise; outdoors + culture/history/museums; Colombia (road trip + Ciudad Perdida) is the template. Mom: no crowds, altitude ceiling ~4,200 m with slow acclimatisation, no Balkans/Baltics/Central Asia; her picks Canada, Norway, Iceland. Antoine: not a full-hike trip. Budget max €15,000 for five, no need to spend it all. Hard limits on dates: 12 July – 20 August 2027.
